description: This file is a shell script used for setting up and testing CVS repository import handling, particularly focusing on vendor branches within a Git environment.

methods.name: setup_cvs_test_repository
methods.description: Sets up a CVS test repository named 't9601' for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a description and a shell command to execute.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines a test case expected to fail, with a description and command.

methods.name: test_cmp_branch_file
methods.description: Compares the contents of a branch with an expected file to verify correctness.

methods.name: test_cvs_co
methods.description: Checks out a CVS repository branch.

methods.name: test_git_co
methods.description: Checks out a Git branch for testing.
